copy.en:
Smooth Control, Eight Wheels
Eight double swivel wheels turn 360° for easier movement through airports and city streets.
Aluminium handle with three height settings
PC+ABS shell, vertical texture, four protective corners
copy.zh:
360°灵活顺滑，八轮驱动
8个双排万向轮可360°转向，便于穿行机场与城市街道。
铝合金拉杆，三挡高度调节
PC+ABS箱壳、竖纹表面与四个防撞角
copy.de:
Wendig unterwegs mit acht Rollen
Acht doppelte 360°-Doppelrollen erleichtern das Bewegen an Flughäfen und durch die Stadt.
Aluminiumgriff mit drei Höheneinstellungen
PC+ABS-Schale, vertikale Struktur, vier Schutzkappen
copy.fr:
Huit roues, contrôle fluide
Huit doubles roulettes pivotantes à 360° facilitent les déplacements dans les aéroports et en ville.
Poignée aluminium à trois hauteurs
Coque PC+ABS, texture verticale, quatre coins protecteurs
copy.it:
Otto ruote, movimento fluido
Otto doppie ruote girevoli a 360° facilitano gli spostamenti in aeroporto e in città.
Manico in alluminio, tre altezze
Scocca PC+ABS, texture verticale, quattro angoli protettivi
copy.es:
Ocho ruedas, movimiento fluido
Ocho ruedas dobles giratorias 360° facilitan el desplazamiento en aeropuertos y calles urbanas.
Asa de aluminio, tres alturas
Carcasa de PC+ABS, textura vertical, cuatro esquinas protectoras

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为“360°双排万向轮（8轮）”，用明确的轮组特写证明转向结构，并以实际使用路径传达机场与城市移动更方便；不得声称静音、耐磨或适用于所有地面，因为资料未提供这些证据。PC端采用左文右产品：2000×2000画布，左侧文案区约[x=0.05,y=0.10,w=0.38,h=0.80]，右侧产品区约[x=0.49,y=0.08,w=0.46,h=0.84]。阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、铝合金拉杆与三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳及结构细节。产品右侧以45度前侧视角展示真实箱体、八个双排轮和拉杆；在轮组旁安排局部放大视图或细线指向，展示双排与360°转向；箱壳局部展示竖纹、四个防撞角和PC+ABS材质外观，但不渲染“防刮”结论。移动端改为上方场景/下方文案：1200×1200画布，产品与机场或城市人行道场景位于[x=0.08,y=0.05,w=0.84,h=0.53]，文案位于[x=0.05,y=0.64,w=0.90,h=0.31]，保持轮组特写在上方视觉中心。采用低饱和中性色、自然侧光和柔和接触阴影，突出金属拉杆、箱壳纹理及轮组层次；避免过度反光和改变产品颜色。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题最大，支持说明次之，两个细节采用短行和清晰数字；德语排版预留约20%扩展空间。第一行对应主标题，第二行对应八轮转向及使用收益，第三行对应铝合金拉杆和三挡调节，第四行对应PC+ABS箱壳、竖纹和四个防撞角。资料未提供可量化耐刮测试，因此设计 brief 明确保留该证据缺口，图片只展示结构，不写耐刮承诺。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的PC、ABS、铝合金、360°双排八轮、三挡拉杆、竖纹和四个防撞角事实；不宣称防刮、静音、耐磨、适配所有地面或官方认证。不得添加竞品标识、虚构测试、评分、保证或促销信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European-modern Amazon product visual for the supplied YWJ Model 13A travel suitcase, matching the actual product shape, color, materials, vertical shell texture, aluminium handle, eight double swivel wheels, and four protective corners. Use a low-saturation neutral palette with natural side lighting and soft contact shadows. Desktop composition: suitcase large on the right in a three-quarter front view, with the wheel assembly clearly visible; left side is a clean reserved copy area occupying about 38% of the canvas. Add a realistic airport terminal or clean city sidewalk context, with a subtle motion path suggesting easy 360-degree maneuvering. Include a tasteful close-up inset of the double-wheel assembly and a second close-up of the vertical shell texture and protective corner, without changing the product design. Mobile composition: product and travel context in the upper portion, with clear empty space below for copy. Keep the product as the single visual focus, maintain accurate proportions, and do not show extra accessories or unsupported features. NO rendered text, NO logos beyond the supplied product, NO badges, NO icons with words, NO claims, NO labels, NO decorative typography.
